data.fund_type: An Open Ended Hybrid Scheme Investing Predominantly In Equity And Equity Related Instruments
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme would be to generate long term Capital appreciation and current income with reduced volatility by investing in a judicious mix of a diversified portfolio of equity and equity related investments, debt and money market instruments.
data.asset_allocation: Equity,  Equity related instruments and Derivatives: 65% to 80%;  Debt instruments (including fixed/ floating rate debt instruments) and Money Market instruments: 20% to 35%
data.fund_managers: Mr. Deepak Ramaraju, Mr. Sudip More, Mr. Prateek Nigudkar and Mr. Amit Modani
data.exit_load: If redeemed / switched-out within 90 days from the date of allotment :- • Upto 12% of units: Nil • More than 12% of units: 1% of applicable Net Asset Value (NAV) If redeemed/switched-out after 90 days from the date of allotment: Nil
